verifier_check.interpretation: The frozen verifier intentionally rejects any post-warmup retained-counter value above batch-4 baseline, including +1; no threshold was changed.

conclusion.supported: S190 failure boundary is accurately captured; S188 demonstrates non-monotonic runtime handle variation under the same Windows sampler family.
conclusion.not_proven: No collector error, ownership, leak, or root cause is proven. S190 remains a failed partial attempt and cannot be joined into GT06 acceptance.
conclusion.decision: Do not retry unchanged. Keep GT06 gate, timeout, baseline, profile, counter and RSS policy unchanged. A new formal run requires a supported distinct measurement/attribution route or an owner-approved ADR; static GT07-GT10 preparation may proceed without opening their gates.
